role: Purely adversarial read-only challenger; findings only, no implementation or approval authority

findings.title: Separate common and mode-specific font validation in the existing compositor
findings.evidence: The metrics predicate at line28 combines metric and nonmetric branches in one long &&/|| expression. The glyph and rectangle predicates at lines41 and51 repeat metric/!metric terms alongside common UTF-8, advance and geometry guards. Checking one invariant requires mentally carrying both mode alternatives and operator precedence across unrelated checks. This is a concrete readability cost in the shared preflight owner, not a demonstrated acceptance/refusal defect.
findings.reproduction: Read composeCells preflight with Em=0 and then Em=24: independently trace permitted ascent/descent/cap-height, Left, advance and tile dimensions through lines28,41,51. The same mode decision must be reconstructed in each mixed predicate. Existing binary/native refusal tables already exercise both modes.
findings.recommendation: Keep composeCells as owner. Separate common checks from explicit metric/else guards, preserve existing error messages and refusal order, and keep all current validation. Add no helper, mode field, adapter or dependency. Verify existing binary/native refusals and goldens after the edit.
findings.root_disposition: Root accepted this finding and plans that local guard refactor; no implementation or post-fix verification was inspected by this auditor.

conclusion: One low-severity readability finding. No reproducible functional defect, unjustified additional function, or unsupported reduction/coverage claim established in this bounded inspection. This report grants no integration, family-promotion, retirement or ISO-apply approval.
